bio.text: Brinker Harding is the Republican candidate for Nebraska's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election and has served on the Omaha City Council since 2017.
Before joining the council he served as chief of staff and director of economic development for former Omaha Mayor Hal Daub.

According to the Flatwater Free Press, he later worked as a commercial real estate developer, and he is a fourth-generation Omaha resident who attended Westside High School and graduated from Deerfield Academy in Massachusetts.
